predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 runs formal field-ownership and invariant analysis while agent 1 runs empirical downstream contract and failure recomposition on the composite methodology and source-corpus axis; a bias in agent 0 toward normalized elegance would be exposed by agent 1 when serialization or consumer behavior needs self-contained data, while a bias in agent 1 toward convenient copies would be exposed by agent 0 when duplicated semantics create drift or competing authority.
